notes: 修复「工作区显示」卡片的会话名称与 DSH 面板不一致：DSH 会话标题会演进（fallback 临时标题 → provider 正式标题），卡片之前取第一条 fallback 就停止；现在按 provider > fallback > 无来源 title > 首条用户消息 的优先级取最新标题，与 DSH 面板显示完全一致。
notesEn: Fix session names in the "Workspace visibility" card differing from the DSH panel: DSH titles evolve (fallback -> provider). The card previously stopped at the first fallback; it now picks the latest by priority provider > fallback > untagged title > first user message, matching DSH exactly.
